set.body:
Type: implementation task (sub-task of F02.3)
Work key: F02.3.5
Parent: F02.3 (bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (transition table, public API contract), ADR 003 (recovery)

Scope: a frozen move request (destination, policy, access-impact preview, generations) approved by the explicit dataset steward and the source and destination project stewards; commit rechecks every approval, status and generation; survivors (grants, stewards) listed; optional old link only on request.
Acceptance: missing approval, stale preview after membership change, archived project and partial approval are refused; a committed move keeps release IDs, bytes, receipts and custody unchanged.
set.title: F02.3.5: Governed dataset move requests with steward approvals
